title: Umami-forward
summary: Umami is the fifth taste — savory depth from soy, parmesan, mushrooms, tomato paste, and slow browning.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — umami-forward is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: salt, ferment, glutamate. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Add tomato paste and brown it
Finish with parmesan or fish sauce
Pair with acid (lemon, vinegar) so richness does not taste flat or heavy.
